text:
maria: Hey team — customer reports 404 on a new route after upgrading @redwood/sdk (TS) to 1.3.0. Works with curl. Probable param rename? :thinking_face:
conor: Can you paste the snippet they're calling and the exact error? 404 + response body would help.
maria: Logged stack: `Error: 404 Not Found - /v1/engines/reorder/run` Response: `{"error":"route not found"}`. Using `client.models.run({ engine: 'reorder', prompt })` from TS SDK.
lee: That endpoint path looks like old server route. New API uses `/v1/models/{model}/invoke` and TS SDK v1.3 switched to `model` param name. If their app is still using `engine` it might be building a different URL.
maria: Hmm they said they didn't change code, just bumped deps. I asked for package.json and they confirmed `@redwood/sdk@1.3.0`.
conor: Ok, two possibilities: 1) SDK introduced a codegen change mapping `engine` -> `model` and also changes base path for certain routes -> causing 404 if server version doesn't support v2 paths. 2) There's a server compatibility flag. Ask customer for `X-Redwood-API-Version` header in the request and output of `curl -i` to reproduce.
maria: Customer sent curl repro that works: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/reorder/invoke -d '{"input":"hi"}'`. But their Node client call gets 404.
lee: Sounds like SDK is generating `/v1/engines/reorder/run` when `engine` param is present. In 1.3 we added a compatibility alias but it seems broken when `apiVersion` isn't set. Temporary workaround: pin `@redwood/sdk@1.2.7` or explicitly pass `client = new RedwoodClient({ apiVersion: '202401-compat' })`.
maria: Pushed those two options to the customer. They asked if we can hotfix SDK or patch server to accept both routes.
conor: Short-term: downgrade pin. Medium: release 1.3.1 that detects usage of `engine` and routes to new path. I'll open a patch PR.
lee: For the support ticket include repro steps so QA can validate patch: 1) install @redwood/sdk@1.3.0, 2) run node snippet:```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.TOKEN })
await client.models.run({ engine: 'reorder', input: 'test' })
``` 3) expect 404; then retry with pinned 1.2.7 and expect 200.
maria: I'll attach logs and curl output to the ticket and advise downgrade + monitor. Adding note about billing/invoice: no billing impact, just missing route.
support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026 — SDK 1.3.0 route compatibility. Assigned to eng. :white_check_mark:
